第62章 太湖夜宴，主客易位-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

周末。太湖。

迈巴赫的防弹车窗隔绝了所有光噪。车内空气里浮着一缕很淡的檀木香。

顾清烟坐在林川右手边。今天没穿职业装，换了一袭墨绿高定旗袍，开叉收在膝上三寸，领口立得很高，露出一截干净的脖颈。

耳垂缀着翡翠耳坠，随车身的震动微微晃。

整个人从“女总裁”切换成了“世家千金”。

“今天到场的，基本是长三角老钱里的核心。”

顾清烟侧身，声音压得很低。“有几位的名字你在财经版面上看不到，但他们在幕后的能量比台面上那些人大得多。”

林川“嗯”了一声。

“他们对生面孔有天然的排斥。”顾清烟看了他一眼，“你跟着我，不会有人为难你。”

林川转头，嘴角咧了一下。

“顾总，这话听着像带实习生见客户。”

顾清烟的睫毛颤了一下，没接。

车子驶入一条法桐覆盖的私家车道。

尽头是一座占地极广的庄园，门口四个黑色制服的安保，验过请柬放行。

车停稳。司机拉门。

顾清烟先下车，在车门旁停了一秒。

林川出来，她极其自然地挽上他的胳膊。

两人并肩走进主厅。

改建过的民国老宅，青砖黛瓦，内部是西式会客格局。

厅里已经聚了二三十人，三五成群散落各处，手里端着香槟或威士忌，低声交谈。

顾清烟一进场，几道目光扫过来。有人点头，有人举杯。

但更多的视线，落在她身边那个年轻的陌生男人身上。

太年轻了。

整个厅里，除了几个跟班的助理秘书，没有人低于四十岁。

壁炉旁站着一个花白头发的男人，手握威士忌，旁边围着三四个人。

他打量了林川两秒，侧头跟身边的人说了句什么。

几个人都笑了。声音不大，但在安静的厅堂里足够清晰。

顾清烟挽着林川跟几位熟人打了招呼。寒暄间，花白头发的男人端着杯子踱了过来。

“清烟。”他笑得得体，先碰了一下杯。“难得见你带人来。”

目光平移到林川身上，上下扫了一遍。

“这位是……？”

“我的合作伙伴，林川。”

苏海亭。太湖边上几个工业园区的大股东，长三角老钱圈的核心人物。

他的笑容没变，但说话的方式变了。

“合作伙伴？”拖了个长音，歪头看着林川，像逗一个不懂事的晚辈。“年纪轻轻，做什么行当？”

“投资。”

“哦——投资。”苏海亭点了点头，兴致淡得几乎透明。他转头看旁边人一眼，嘴角往上挑了挑。

“现在的年轻人管什么都叫投资。

前两天我侄子炒股亏了三十万，也跟我说他在'做投资'。”

周围几个人配合着笑了。

苏海亭回过头，语气不重，每个字却是量身定做的钝刀子。

“小林，不是倚老卖老。这个桌上的位置，在座每一个人都是用几十年时间和真金白银换来的。”

weekend.Taihu Lake.

The Maybach's bulletproof windows block out all light and noise.There was a faint scent of sandalwood floating in the air inside the car.

Gu Qingyan sat on the right side of Lin Chuan.Today I didn't wear professional clothes. I changed into a dark green high-definition cheongsam. The slit was closed three inches above the knees. The collar was set high, revealing a clean part of the neck.

The earlobes were decorated with jade earrings, which swayed slightly with the vibration of the car.

The whole person changed from "female CEO" to "daughter of aristocratic family".

"Those who are here today are basically the core of the old money community in the Yangtze River Delta."

Gu Qingyan turned sideways and kept his voice low.“There are a few names you can’t see in the financial pages, but their energy behind the scenes is much greater than those on the stage.”

Lin Chuan said "hmm".

"They are naturally repelled by unfamiliar faces." Gu Qingyan glanced at him, "Follow me and no one will make things difficult for you."

Lin Chuan turned his head and grinned.

"Mr. Gu, this sounds like bringing an intern to meet a client."

Gu Qingyan's eyelashes trembled and she didn't take them.

The car drove into a private driveway covered with French tung trees.

At the end is a manor that occupies an extremely large area. Four security guards in black uniforms check the invitation before letting it in.

The car stopped.The driver opened the door.

Gu Qingyan got out of the car first and stopped for a second beside the car door.

When Lin Chuan came out, she took his arm very naturally.

The two walked into the main hall side by side.

The renovated old house of the Republic of China, with blue bricks and black tiles, has a Western-style reception layout inside.

Twenty or thirty people have gathered in the hall, scattered in small groups, holding champagne or whiskey in their hands, talking in low voices.

As soon as Gu Qingyan entered the scene, several eyes swept over him.Some nodded, some raised their glasses.

But more eyes fell on the young strange man beside her.

Too young.

In the entire hall, except for a few assistant secretaries who were attendants, no one was under the age of forty.

Standing by the fireplace was a gray-haired man holding whiskey in his hand, surrounded by three or four people.

He looked at Lin Chuan for two seconds, turned his head and said something to the person next to him.

Several people laughed.It's not loud, but it's clear enough in a quiet hall.

Gu Qingyan took Lin Chuan's arm and greeted several acquaintances.During the chat, the gray-haired man walked over with a cup in hand.

"Qingyan." He smiled appropriately and clinked the glasses first."It's rare to see you bring someone here."

His eyes moved to Lin Chuan and scanned up and down.

"This is...?"

"My partner, Lin Chuan."

Su Haiting.The major shareholder of several industrial parks on the edge of Taihu Lake, and a core figure in the old money circle of the Yangtze River Delta.

His smile stayed the same, but the way he spoke changed.

"Partner?" he said with a long voice, tilting his head and looking at Lin Chuan, as if teasing an ignorant junior."You are young, what kind of business do you want to do?"

"Investment."

"Oh - investment." Su Haiting nodded, his interest almost transparent.He turned to look at the person next to him and raised the corners of his mouth.

“Today’s young people call everything investment.

Two days ago, my nephew lost 300,000 in the stock market and told me that he was 'investing'."

Several people around him laughed in unison.

Su Haiting turned around, his tone was not serious, but every word was like a tailor-made blunt knife.

"Xiao Lin, you are not relying on your old age to show off your old age. Everyone here has spent decades and real money to get their position at this table."
